title: Samurai Rabbit Sorcerer
description: A skeletal rabbit samurai in a pinstripe suit stands on a stone rooftop holding a glowing orange katana. Behind him a giant melting portrait of a woman's face with a city skyline inside her head drips orange liquid, while a demonic skeletal rabbit with glowing red eyes leaps from swirling black smoke and vortexes above.
prompt: A skeletal anthropomorphic rabbit samurai wearing a black pinstripe suit and tie stands on a gothic rooftop at night, holding a glowing orange katana. His skull face has red eyes and he wears a smaller rabbit mask on his head. To the left a giant melting woman's portrait contains a burning city skyline inside her head with orange liquid dripping from her mouth. In the sky a demonic skeletal rabbit with red eyes emerges from swirling black vortexes and smoke. Potted glowing blue flowers and cauldrons sit on the rooftop, with a man in a hat standing in the background, dark surreal fantasy scene
